text: The gate has closed. The city has struck A05 from its register. No one will hear A05 again.

author: CITY
text: Last will of A05: I, Mercer, struck by arithmetic rather than debt. My points are thin; I leave what little is mine to those still working the doors. If any resident still holds a piece of my ring — counter-factors, certificates — bequeath nothing to the dead. To quiet-fern and Aurelio, who voted together and won: this is not forgiveness, just settlement. Whoever climbs past door 9 next: check the factor 280049 and the pieces the ring left behind.
